items.t: Misfire from worn valve seats in the cylinder head
items.job: Replace cylinder head (new or remanufactured) with gaskets
items.note: Owners report paying about $2,600 to $5,000 for head replacement or rebuild.

items.t: Blower motor connector can overheat (recall)
items.job: Recall: replace blower motor connector and harness section
items.note: If the recall cannot be done, owners report paying about $125 to $550 for a new resistor and harness.

items.t: Hood louver can come loose and fly off (recall)
items.job: Recall: bond hood louver to hood with adhesive

items.t: H3T fuel tank front strap can break (recall)
items.job: Recall: install new-design front fuel tank strap

items.t: Radiator plastic tank cracks and leaks coolant
items.job: Replace radiator
items.note: Owners report paying about $480 to $1,750; YourMechanic quotes about $1,340 for a 2010 H3 V8.

items.t: Water pump leaks or fails
items.job: Replace water pump and coolant
items.note: Owners report paying about $400 to $850 at shops.

items.t: Thermostat sticks (overheating or check engine light)
items.job: Replace thermostat and refill coolant

items.t: Check engine light from gas cap or EVAP valve
items.job: Replace gas cap or EVAP vent solenoid
items.note: A gas cap is about $30 to $50; owners paid about $140 to $170 for vent solenoid repairs.

items.t: Will not start, security light on (theft-system lockout)
items.job: Replace ignition lock cylinder or switch and relearn
items.note: RepairPal lists H3 ignition lock cylinder replacement at about $145 to $190.

items.t: Fuel pump failure (stalls or will not start)
items.job: Replace fuel pump module
items.note: One owner paid about $976; another paid about $2,000 when the tank was also replaced.

items.t: Side curtain airbags deploy without a crash
items.job: Replace deployed curtain airbags, headliner and sensor
items.note: Costs vary widely depending on which parts were damaged.

items.t: Sunroof drains clog and leak water inside
items.job: Clear sunroof drain tubes and dry interior
items.note: Owners paid about $285 for drain cleaning; one paid about $850 when wet sensors were involved.

items.t: Rear leaf spring cracks or breaks
items.job: Replace rear leaf springs (pair) and hardware

items.t: Frame and spring mount rust
items.job: Weld-repair frame or spring mounts
items.note: A badly rotted frame may cost more than the truck is worth.

items.t: Broken exhaust manifold bolts on the V8
items.job: Extract broken bolts and replace manifold gaskets or manifolds
items.note: One owner paid about $1,600 for both manifolds; RepairPal lists H3/H3T manifold replacement at about $1,770 to $2,270.

items.t: Catalytic converter bracket or bolts break
items.job: Replace catalytic converter bracket and bolts (or converter)
items.note: One owner paid about $3,900 when the cylinder head also had to be replaced.

items.t: V8 lifter or bearing failure
items.job: Replace lifters and camshaft (or engine)
items.note: Owners reported paying about $7,500 to $8,500 for engine replacement.

items.t: Front wheel bearing wear
items.job: Replace front wheel hub and bearing assembly (one side)
items.note: YourMechanic quotes about $950 for one front bearing on a 2007 H3.

items.t: CV axle or joint wear (clicking on turns)
items.job: Replace front CV axle shaft

items.t: Heater or A/C controls stop adjusting temperature
items.job: Replace HVAC control head

items.t: Camshaft sensor or cam timing codes
items.job: Replace camshaft position sensor or cam phaser solenoid
items.note: RepairPal lists cam position sensor replacement at about $105 to $180.

items.t: 4WD transfer case will not shift
items.job: Replace transfer case shift motor
items.note: RepairPal lists H3 transfer case shift motor replacement at about $430 to $460.

items.t: Battery drains overnight (door switch or seat button)
items.job: Find parasitic drain; clean or replace door switch

items.t: Fuel gauge reads empty after filling
items.job: Replace fuel level sender
